author: GuyNamedRiley
body:
So I came across this song about 2 weeks ago called Nightstruck by Mendum. It honestly blew me away and that was kind of the inspiration of this map. At first I didn't want to call it by the name Nightstruck because then I thought that it wouldn't be original enough, but then I thought, what the heck! I was also gladly joined by some of the best builders in Avicus!

I was able to work at the very beginning with Awesomerp who helped me plan out this whole map and got the general structure, Snow and Jahaj were able to help contribute so many ideas to this map that it was amazing, the return of Zintenka was a blessing to me seeing as how he can take the average map, and make it look so much more vibrant than ever before (Love ya <3), and Dawning for adding some finishing touches!

So without further ado, introducing...







Map name: Nightstruck
Creator: GuyNamedRiley, Awesomerp, Zintenka, Jahaj, SnowSX3, Dawning_
Gamemode: FFA
Download link: http://www.mediafire.com/download/qi6xym6nbnjgvdz/Badrile.rar
YML: http://pastebin.com/c0TuSgY6
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/Ew75a

Feedback is much appreciated!
